_comment: AUTHORED OWNERSHIP DECISIONS for BSB60420. There are none, and that is the finding.
_deliveredNote: Ten units over 52 weeks, all delivered, no credit-transfer pathway. THE OVERLAP DETECTOR FOUND NOTHING at the 0.45 threshold: not one knowledge-evidence point or element in this qualification is restated in another of its units. Every unit teaches its own requirements in full and no ruling was needed. That is a real result rather than a gap - a qualification of ten senior management units drawn from different competency fields has little common scaffolding to duplicate, which is exactly the opposite of a cookery qualification where twelve units all describe storing food.
